title: Additional Hyd Oil Filter Clogging
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a clogged hydraulic oil additional filter.
machine_effect: If the machine continues to be operated, the hydraulic components can suffer a damage.

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. For details, see RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT, CHECKS BEFORE TROU- BLESHOOTING, Electrical equipment. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Check if the hydraulic oil additional filter is clogged. 2. Is the hydraulic oil additional filter normal? Abnormal phenomenon The hydraulic oil additional filter is clogged.

branches.YES: • The hydraulic oil additional filter is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The hydraulic oil additional filter is defective. • Clean or replace the hydraulic oil additional filter. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Clogging switch for hydraulic oil additional filter
steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector P68. Connect the T-adapter to the male side. 3. Measure the resistance. 4. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? Stand- Measuring point and measurement Item ard valcondition ue Resist- Max. 1 Between P68 (male) (1) and (2) ance Ω

branches.YES: • The clogging switch for the hydraulic oil additional filter is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The clogging switch for the hydraulic oil additional filter is defective. • Replace the clogging switch for the hydraulic oil additional filter. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector CP01 and P68. Connect the T-adapter to each female side. 3. Measure the resistance. 4. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? Stand- Measuring point and measurement Item ard valcondition ue Between CP01 (female) (17) and Max. 1 P68 (female) (1) Ω Resistance Between P68 (female) (2) and Max. 1 ground Ω

branches.YES: • The wiring harness has no open circuits. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The wiring harness has an open circuit. • Repair or replace the wiring harness. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting above again. 2. Can you identify the cause by reconfirmation?

branches.NO: • The pump controller can be defective. • Replace the pump controller. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Connect all the configuration equipment. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position to troubleshoot. 4. Check the abnormality record. 5. Is this failure code shown in the record?

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
